ingredients: 1/2 cup water (add more water at any time if needed)
instructions: Decarb your weed - Learn how

Add ½ cup of water and 2 sticks (½ lb) of butter in a saucepan and bring to a simmer on low to medium heat. Adding water helps to regulate the temperature and prevents the butter from scorching. As butter begins to melt, add in ground weed.
Maintain low heat and let the mixture simmer for 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally. Make sure the mixture never comes to a full boil.

Pour the hot mixture into a glass container, using a cheesecloth to strain out all ground weed from the butter mixture. Squeeze or press the plant material to get as much liquid out of the weed as possible. Discard leftover weed.

Cover and refrigerate remaining liquid overnight or until the butter is fully hardened. Once hardened, the butter will separate from the water, allowing you to lift the cannabutter out of the container. Discard remaining water after removing the hardened cannabutter.
Note that the cannabutter in the container should have a slightly green tinge from the cannabis. Now you are ready to make some cannabis-infused meals!
Decarb your weed - Learn how to do
Add the weed to a canning jar with ½ cup of coconut oil.
Seal the canning jar very tightly.
Add the canning jar in boiling water using low-medium (240° F - 115° C) heat for over 2 hours.
Put all the jar's content into a cheesecloth over a metal strainer.
Gather the cheesecloth and squeeze all the remaining liquid out.
Decarb your weed - Learn how to do
Grind your weed fine, you want to make a good surface area of exposure.
Add the ground weed to a canning jar with 300 ml of olive oil.
Seal the canning jar very tightly.
Add the canning jar in boiling water using low-medium (240° F - 115° C) heat for over 2 hours.
Put all the jar's content into a cheesecloth over a metal strainer.
Gather the cheesecloth and squeeze all the remaining liquid out.
Brew a cup of coffee using your preferred method.
In a blender, combine the brewed coffee, unsalted butter, coconut oil, and cannabis-infused coconut oil.
Blend on high speed until the mixture is creamy and frothy.
Taste and add sweetener if desired.
Pour into a mug and enjoy your keto-friendly cannabis-infused bulletproof coffee!

ingredients: 1/2 cup powdered erythritol or low-carb sweetener of choice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine the natural peanut butter, powdered erythritol, egg, vanilla extract, cannabis-infused coconut oil, and salt.
Mix until well combined and a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 15 equal portions (a heaped tablespoon each) and roll them into balls. One cookie is one serving.
Place the dough balls onto the prepared baking sheet and flatten them with a fork, making a crisscross pattern.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until the cookies are golden around the edges.
Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Enjoy your delicious cannabis-infused keto peanut butter cookies!

ingredients: 1/4 cup powdered erythritol or sweetener of choice
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the melted coconut oil, coconut butter, cannabis-infused coconut oil, unsweetened cocoa powder, powdered erythritol, vanilla extract, and salt.
Stir until well combined and smooth.
Pour the mixture evenly into 12 cavities of a silicone mold or ice cube tray, about 2 tbsp each.
Place in the refrigerator or freezer to solidify for at least 1 hour.
Pop the coconut fat bombs out of the molds or ice cube tray.
Store the cannabis-infused coconut fat bombs in an airtight container in the refrigerator or freezer.
One serving is one fat bomb: enjoy one as a keto-friendly, cannabis-infused snack.

ingredients: 1 pound pasta (e.g., spaghetti, penne, or fusilli)
instructions: In a food processor, combine the fresh basil leaves, pine nuts, grated Parmesan cheese, and minced garlic.
Pulse the mixture until it forms a coarse paste.
With the food processor running, slowly drizzle in the cannabis-infused olive oil and the plain olive oil until the pesto becomes smooth and well combined.
Season the pesto with salt and pepper to taste. Adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Drain the cooked pasta, reserving a small amount of the cooking water.
In a large mixing bowl, toss the cooked pasta with the cannabis-infused pesto. If needed, add a splash of the reserved cooking water to loosen the sauce.
Divide the pasta among 4 plates and top each with a sprinkle of grated Parmesan cheese.
Enjoy the flavorful and cannabis-infused pasta dish!

ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries)
Optional: a handful of kale for added nutrients
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the sweetness by adding more honey or maple syrup if desired.
If the smoothie is too thick, add a little more milk and blend again until desired consistency is reached.
Pour the cannabis-infused berry smoothie into 2 glasses and serve immediately.

ingredients: 1/2 cup nut butter (such as almond butter or peanut butter)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients: rolled oats, nut butter, honey or maple syrup, ground flaxseed, mini chocolate chips, shredded coconut, vanilla extract, cannabis-infused coconut oil, and a pinch of salt.
Stir well until all the ingredients are evenly combined.
Cover the bowl and place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to allow the mixture to firm up.
After chilling, remove the mixture from the refrigerator and roll it into 16 equal balls using your hands; one ball is one serving.
Place the cannabis-infused energy bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Refrigerate the energy bites for another 1-2 hours to set and firm up.
Once firm, transfer the energy bites to an airtight container and store them in the refrigerator.
Enjoy the cannabis-infused energy bites as a nutritious and tasty snack!
Place your weed on the foil.
Preheat your oven to 250° F.
Toast your weed for 10 minutes at 250° F.
Cover graham crackers with hazelnut spread.
Remove your weed from the oven and sprinkle over the hazelnut spread.
Mix weed into the spread and sandwich graham crackers together.
Wrap and seal the firecracker in foil.
Toast in the oven for 15 minutes at 300° F.

Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Dissolve the infused honey and the sugar in 1 cup of warm water, then pour it into a pitcher with the lemon juice and the other 3 cups of cold water.
Stir well until the sugar is dissolved.
Taste the lemonade and adjust the sweetness by adding more sugar if desired (not more infused honey, which would change the dose).
Add ice cubes to the pitcher to chill the lemonade.
Stir again before serving.
Pour the cannabis-infused lemonade into 6 glasses and garnish with lemon slices.
Sip and enjoy the refreshing and uplifting effects of the cannabis-infused lemonade!

ingredients: 3 tbsp powdered erythritol or sweetener of choice
Optional toppings: whipped cream, berries, chopped nuts
instructions: Cut the avocados in half and remove the pits.
Scoop the flesh into a blender or food processor.
Add the unsweetened cocoa powder, cannabis-infused coconut oil, powdered erythritol, vanilla extract, and salt.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the sweetness if needed.
Divide the cannabis-infused chocolate avocado mousse into serving bowls or glasses.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to chill and set.
Before serving, you can top the mousse with whipped cream, berries, or chopped nuts if desired.
Enjoy your keto-friendly infused chocolate avocado mousse!
Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits, and scoop out the flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocado with a fork until it reaches your desired consistency.
Add the lime juice, onion, tomatoes, garlic, cannabis-infused olive oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
Taste and adjust the seasonings as needed.
Optional: Stir in chopped cilantro and diced jalapenos for added flavor and heat
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or as a topping for tacos, burritos, or sandwiches.

ingredients: Optional coatings: chopped nuts, cocoa powder, shredded coconut
instructions: In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the cannabis-infused coconut oil.
Add the unsweetened cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt to the melted coconut oil. Stir well until smooth and combined.
Place the mixture in the refrigerator for about 1 hour or until firm enough to handle.
Scoop the mixture into 20 equal portions and roll each into a bite-sized truffle with your hands; one truffle is one serving.
Roll the truffles in your desired coatings, such as chopped nuts, cocoa powder, or shredded coconut.
Place the coated truffles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Refrigerate the truffles for at least 1 hour to set.
Serve the cannabis-infused chocolate truffles chilled and enjoy!
Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the melted cannabis-infused butter and granulated sugar.
Add the eggs, mashed bananas, and vanilla extract. Stir well to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture, stirring until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Pour the batter into the greased loaf pan, spreading it out evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove the banana bread from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Slice and enjoy the cannabis-infused banana bread as a delightful and comforting treat!

ingredients: 1/4 cup powdered erythritol or low-carb sweetener of choice
1/2 cup powdered erythritol or low-carb sweetener of choice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C).
In a bowl, combine the almond flour, powdered erythritol, and melted cannabis-infused butter.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a greased square baking pan.
Bake the crust in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and set aside.
In a mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, powdered erythritol, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the baked crust in the baking pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheesecake is set and slightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let the cheesecake cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the cheesecake for at least 4 hours or overnight to firm up.
Cut the chilled cheesecake into 16 squares and serve your cannabis-infused keto cheesecake bites; one square is one serving.
Enjoy these creamy and indulgent treats while sticking to your keto diet!
Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the riced cauliflower in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 5-6 minutes until tender.
Allow the cauliflower to cool slightly, then transfer it to a clean kitchen towel.
Wrap the cauliflower in the towel and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
In a mixing bowl, combine the cauliflower, shredded mozzarella cheese, almond flour, cannabis-infused olive oil, egg, dried oregano, garlic powder, and salt.
Mix until well combined.
Transfer the cauliflower mixture to the prepared baking sheet and shape it into a pizza crust shape.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the crust is golden and firm.
Remove from the oven and add your desired toppings.
Return the pizza to the oven and bake for an additional 8-10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Slice and enjoy your keto-friendly cannabis-infused cauliflower pizza!

ingredients: Milk, Cream, Coconut Milk or Other Milk Substitute
1  ground weed per liter of milk
instructions: Decarb your weed - Learn how to do
Grind your weed fine, you want to make a good surface area of exposure.
Next, add your finely ground cannabis directly to your milk, place over low heat and whisk to combine. Be careful not to let the mixture boil over!
Stir the milk mixture frequently to prevent scorching and allow the cannabis and milk to simmer for 30 minutes to an hour depending on your preferred potency.
After 30 minutes to an hour, remove from heat and let sit for 5-10 minutes to help the cannabinoids set into the fat cells.
Place cheesecloth over the top of a large mason jar or other air-tight liquid storage container then pour the mixture over the cheesecloth to strain out all plant matter.
When it’s cool enough to handle, squeeze all excess liquid from the cheesecloth into your storage container.

Tightly seal your container, label with its contents and expiration date (the same date that was listed on the milk container) or freeze in ice cube trays for later use. One serving is ½ cup (120 ml); the batch makes about 8.
In a large skillet or pot, heat the regular oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic is fragrant.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for an additional minute to toast the spices.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable broth. Stir well to combine.
Add the diced potatoes, sliced carrots, red bell pepper, and cauliflower florets to the pot. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the pot and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. Remove from the heat and stir in the cannabis-infused coconut oil and the plain coconut oil until evenly mixed.
Divide the curry among 4 bowls and serve over cooked rice or with naan bread. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

ingredients: 1/4 cup of infused coconut oil with 3.5 grams weed - See the recipe
instructions: Pour the cold water into a small saucepan and sprinkle the unflavored gelatin and the Jello over it. Let it sit for 5 minutes so the gelatin absorbs the water.
Set the pan over low heat and stir until the gelatin has fully dissolved and the mixture is smooth. Keep it below a simmer; don't let it boil.
Melt the infused coconut oil and stir in the lecithin. Whisk it into the warm gelatin for 2 minutes, until no oil shows on the surface.

Lightly oil the molds. Keep the pan on the lowest heat and stir between fills, and use the dropper to divide all of the mixture evenly among 48 cavities. Leftover mixture means each bear holds less than this page says.
Refrigerate for 1 hour until firm, then unmold.
One serving is 3 bears. New to edibles? Start with 1 bear and wait 2 hours before having more. Keep them in an airtight container in the fridge.
In a large skillet or pot, heat the regular olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, carrot, and celery to the pot. Sauté until the vegetables are softened.
Add the ground beef to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and pepper.
Simmer the sauce on low heat for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti noodles according to the package instructions until al dente.
Once the sauce is ready, remove it from the heat, stir in the cannabis-infused olive oil, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Divide the cooked spaghetti among 4 plates and spoon an equal share of the sauce over each.
Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese and enjoy a comforting and cannabis-infused meal!
Preheat the oven to 350 F.
Microwave the cannabutter for about 40 seconds. Butter should be completely melted but shouldn't be hot.
In a large bowl, mix the cannabutter with the sugars until well-combined.
Stir in vanilla and egg until incorporated.
Add the flour, baking soda, and salt. Spoon the flour into the measuring cup and level it off rather than scooping, so the dough doesn't turn out dry.
Mix the dough until just combined. The dough should be soft and a little sticky but not overly sticky.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into 20 equal balls of about 1.5 tablespoons (medium cookie scoop) and place 2 inches apart on the baking sheet. One serving is one cookie.
Bake for 7-10 minutes, or until cookies are set. They will be puffy and still look a little underbaked in the middle.
Preheat oven to 350° F or 180° C.
Mix the melted cannabutter and sugar until well blended.
Add eggs and vanilla; stir just until blended.
Mix all dry ingredients in a separate bowl.
Stir dry ingredients into the butter/sugar mixture.
Pour into greased 9 x 9 square pan.
Bake for 20 minutes or until sides just start to pull away from the pan.
Cool completely, then cut into 16 squares; one square is one serving.
Evenly spread the regular butter on one side of both pieces of bread. Next, spread the cannabis butter on the other side of the bread.
Place the slice of cheddar cheese on the canna-butter side of the bread. Put the two slices of bread together with the canna-butter side in the middle.
On medium heat, fry the grilled cheese until the cheese has melted and both sides are golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.
In a large bowl, with a hand mixer at slow speed, mix the butter, flour, sugar, egg, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, nutmeg, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until well mixed.
Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350°F.

On a lightly floured surface, working with half of the dough at a time, roll 1/8 inch thick. With floured cookie cutters, cut dough into shapes. Using a metal spatula or pancake turner, place cookies 1/2 inch apart on greased cookie sheets. Re-roll trimmings and continue to cut shapes. Remember to cut 24 cookies --> the right amount of cookies to keep your dose consistent to what you set in the calculator.
Bake for 8 minutes, or until lightly browned. Transfer cookies to racks to cool completely.
To make the icing take the sugar, milk and egg whites and beat it until thick but able to pass through a piping bag or squirt bottle. If it is too thick add more milk gradually.
Have fun decorating the cookies however you want!
Decarb your weed - Learn how
Grind your weed fine, you want to make a good surface area of exposure.
Add the ground weed to a canning jar with ¼ cup of coconut oil.
Seal the canning jar very tightly.
Place the sealed jar in a pot of water and keep the water at a gentle simmer on low-medium heat (about 200° F - 95° C) for 2-3 hours, topping up the water as it evaporates.
Put all the jar's content into a cheesecloth over a metal strainer.
Gather the cheesecloth and squeeze all the remaining liquid out.
Toss the infused coconut oil with the nuts until evenly coated, then divide into 16 portions of 1/4 cup; one portion is one serving.
Decarb your weed - Learn how to do
Grind your weed fine, you want to make a good surface area of exposure.
Add the ground weed to a canning jar with ½ cup of coconut oil.
Seal the canning jar very tightly.
Place the sealed jar in a pot of water and keep the water at a gentle simmer on low-medium heat (about 200° F - 95° C) for 2-3 hours, topping up the water as it evaporates.
Put all the jar's content into a cheesecloth over a metal strainer.
Gather the cheesecloth and squeeze all the remaining liquid out.
Stir the lecithin into the warm strained oil. Gently warm the honey and blend it with the oil until smooth and even; stir the jar before each use, as it can still settle.
Put and store all the mixture in a canning jar or mason jar. One serving is 1 teaspoon (the jar holds about 72).
Decarb your weed - Learn how to do
Pour the bottle of whiskey into a sealable jar (or pour out a little bit of whiskey to make up for the added volume of the weed) and add the ground weed.

Shake the bottle and let it sit, out of the sun, for at least 48 hours. Shake it up at least once a day until it has reached your desired potency - up to one month if possible. The longer it sits, the more potent it will be.

Pour the whiskey mixture into a glass container, using a cheesecloth to strain out all ground weed from the whiskey. Repeat this step as necessary to strain all of the whiskey from the ground weed, and discard the remaining weed. One serving is 15 ml, about half an ounce (the bottle makes about 50).
Decarb your weed - Learn how
Start boiling some milk in a pot.
Lay out some cheesecloth
Mash up your ginger and spices
Put the cannabis with all your mashed spices in a cheesecloth and close it as a tea bag.
Steep the tea bag in the milk for two hours.
Pour the milk in a jug.
Now, it's time to prepare your mug, mix the milk with a black tea bag and add some sugar.

ingredients: ⅓ - ⅔ cups of Popcorn Kernels
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a 2 to 3-quart saucepan or pot with a lid set over medium-high heat. Pour in popcorn kernels and sprinkle enough salt to lightly cover the layer of kernels. Remember, you can always add more salt later. Cover with the lid. (Don't pop the kernels in cannabutter: popping temperatures are high enough to scorch the butter and degrade THC.)

As soon as the kernels start to pop, shake the pan back and forth across the burner constantly until the popping slows down. As soon as the pops are about 2 seconds apart, remove from the heat and pour it into a serving bowl. Taste, and season with additional salt if desired. Drizzle the melted cannabutter over the warm popcorn and toss well so it is evenly coated. Divide into 6 bowls; one bowl is one serving.
Separate the egg yolks from the egg whites.
In a bowl, beat the egg yolks with the sugar until they look pale and the sugar is completely dissolved.

In a medium saucepan, over high heat, combine the milk, heavy cream and nutmeg and bring just to a boil, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and slowly temper the hot mixture into the yolks and sugar mixture. Then return everything to the pan and heat it until the mixture reaches 160 degrees F. Remove from the heat, stir in the bourbon/whiskey, pour into a medium mixing bowl, and set in the refrigerator to chill

In a medium mixing bowl, beat the egg whites to soft peaks. With the mixer running gradually add the 1 tablespoon of sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Whisk the egg whites into the chilled mixture.
Serve in how many cups you defined as portions in the calculator to keep your dose consistent, and garnish it with cinnamon!
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat. It will begin to foam and crackle — that is the water evaporating.
Once the crackling subsides and the milk solids settle to the bottom and turn golden, add your decarboxylated cannabis.
Simmer on the lowest heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not let it burn.
Strain through cheesecloth into a mason jar, squeezing out all the fat.
Let cool at room temperature, then refrigerate. Ghee will solidify and keep for up to 3 months.

ingredients: 1 tbsp cannabutter or infused coconut oil
instructions: Make sure your cannabutter or infused coconut oil is ready. If not, prepare it first.
Pour the condensed milk into a saucepan over low heat.
Add the cannabutter or infused coconut oil and whisk until fully combined.
Keep stirring on low heat for 10-15 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer to a mason jar or airtight container. Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. One serving is 1 tablespoon (the batch makes about 20).

ingredients: 2 cups infused milk (see Infused Milk recipe)
2 tbsp sugar or sweetener of choice
instructions: Warm the infused milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Do not boil.
Whisk in cocoa powder, sugar, and salt until fully dissolved and smooth.
Add vanilla extract and stir to combine.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream if desired.
Serve immediately and enjoy slowly — edibles take time to kick in.

ingredients: 1 tsp infused coconut oil (see Infused Coconut Oil recipe)
instructions: Combine ground coffee and cold water in a large jar. Stir to fully saturate the grounds.
Cover and refrigerate for 12-24 hours.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth into a clean jar. Discard grounds.
To serve, fill a glass with ice and pour cold brew to taste (usually diluted 1:1 with water or milk).
Stir in 1 tsp of infused coconut oil until emulsified. You can use a small frother to blend it thoroughly.
Enjoy slowly — the effects combine with caffeine for a unique experience.

ingredients: 6 cups rice cereal (Rice Krispies or similar)
instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch pan with cooking spray and set aside.
Melt cannabutter in a large pot over low heat. Keep the heat low to preserve THC.
Add marshmallows and stir constantly until fully melted and smooth. Remove from heat.
Quickly stir in the rice cereal and salt, mixing until fully coated.
Pour into the prepared pan and press flat with a greased spatula or your hands.
Let cool completely (about 30 minutes), then cut into 12 equal squares.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.

ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream, at room temperature
instructions: Heat sugar in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until it melts and turns amber in color.
Once fully melted, add cannabutter all at once. The mixture will bubble vigorously — keep stirring.
Stir in the heavy cream slowly. Mixture will bubble again. Keep stirring until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and sea salt.
Let cool for 10 minutes before using. Store in a jar in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
Reheat gently before serving. Divide into 12 portions and drizzle as a topping.

ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
3 tbsp infused olive oil (see Infused Olive Oil recipe)
Paprika and regular olive oil to garnish
instructions: Add chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and cumin to a food processor.
Blend for about 1 minute until roughly combined.
With the processor running, drizzle in the infused olive oil and cold water.
Blend for another 2-3 minutes until very smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust salt or lemon to preference.
Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with regular olive oil, and dust with paprika.
Divide into 8 portions for accurate dosing. Store refrigerated for up to 5 days.

ingredients: 3 tbsp cannabutter or infused coconut oil, melted
1/2 cup dried fruit (optional, add after baking)
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C) — lower temperature preserves THC.
In a large bowl, mix oats, nuts, seeds, cinnamon, and salt.
In a small bowl, whisk together melted cannabutter, honey, and vanilla.
Pour wet ingredients over dry and toss until fully coated.
Spread on a parchment-lined baking sheet in a thin, even layer.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until golden and fragrant.
Remove and let cool completely — it will crisp up as it cools.
Stir in dried fruit if using. Divide into 12 portions for accurate dosing.

ingredients: 2 slices of thick bread (sourdough or whole grain)
1 tbsp infused olive oil (see Infused Olive Oil recipe)
Chili flakes, everything bagel seasoning, or fresh herbs to garnish
instructions: Toast your bread to your preferred doneness.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Mix briefly — keep it chunky.
Spread avocado mixture generously over toasted bread.
Mix the infused and regular olive oil and drizzle half over each slice.
Garnish with chili flakes, seasoning, or herbs. Add a poached egg if desired.
Serves 2: one serving is one slice of toast. Eat mindfully and wait at least an hour before considering another portion.

ingredients: 3 tbsp infused olive oil (see Infused Olive Oil recipe)
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar or red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small jar with a lid.
Shake vigorously until emulsified and well combined.
Taste and adjust acid or sweetness to your preference.
Drizzle over salad right before serving — do not dress salad ahead of time.
This recipe makes 4 portions. Keep the dressing jar in the fridge for up to 1 week.
Shake before each use as the oil and vinegar will separate.

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (85% cacao or higher for keto)
1/4 cup toppings: sea salt flakes, chopped nuts, dried cranberries, or cacao nibs
instructions: Melt dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water (double boiler), stirring until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in softened cannabutter until fully incorporated.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Pour the chocolate mixture and spread into an even layer about 1/4 inch thick.
Quickly sprinkle your chosen toppings over the surface.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes until completely set and firm.
Cut or break into 12 equal pieces; one piece is one serving. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

ingredients: 2 flax eggs (2 tbsp flax + 6 tbsp water)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Make flax eggs; rest 5 min.
Whisk cannabis oil, sugar, flax eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, cocoa, salt and baking powder.
Stir in chips. Pour into greased 8x8 pan.
Bake 25-30 min. Cool completely, then cut into 16 squares; one square is one serving.
Drain cashews and blend with all ingredients until silky.
Warm in a saucepan over low heat.
Adjust seasoning with salt and divide into 6 portions of about 1/4 cup; one portion is one serving.
Sauté onion and garlic. Add carrots, cumin, coriander and turmeric.
Add lentils and broth. Simmer 25 min.
Blend half for creamier texture.
Off heat: stir in cannabis olive oil and lemon. Season with salt and ladle into 4 bowls.
Mix oat milk and vinegar; rest 5 min.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add cannabis oil and vanilla to oat milk mixture.
Combine wet and dry until just mixed.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in 1/4 cup batter per pancake to make 8 pancakes; cook 2-3 min per side. One pancake is one serving.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder.
Add sweet potatoes, coconut milk and broth. Simmer 20 min.
Add chickpeas; cook 5 min more.
Off heat: stir in cannabis coconut oil, lime and cilantro. Season with salt and divide among 4 bowls.
Shred jackfruit with a fork.
Season and pan-fry until edges caramelise.
Off heat: stir through cannabis olive oil.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado and salsa.
Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Taste and adjust sweetness.
Divide into 4 small glasses and chill 1 hour before serving.
Top with berries or coconut cream.
Cook the macaroni in salted water; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Blend cashews, cannabis oil, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, onion powder, turmeric and ½ cup of the pasta water until smooth.
Toss drained pasta with sauce over low heat, adding water as needed.
Season with salt and divide among 4 bowls.

ingredients: 2 cans full-fat coconut milk chilled overnight
instructions: Scoop solid cream from top of cans and beat until fluffy.
Melt both coconut oils until just liquid, then beat them into the whipped cream with the maple syrup, vanilla and salt until smooth, so the oil spreads before it sets.
Freeze 4-6 hours. Let sit 5 min, then divide into 8 scoops; one scoop is one serving.
Sauté onion and garlic. Add the smoked paprika, cumin and cayenne.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 20 min.
Off heat: stir in cannabis olive oil. Season, ladle into 4 bowls and garnish with parsley.
Mix all ingredients until combined. Chill 15 min if sticky.
Roll into 20 equal balls (about 2 tablespoons each); one ball is one serving.
Refrigerate 30 min before serving. Keeps 1 week chilled.
Blend basil, nuts, garlic, lemon and cannabis oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Briefly sauté zucchini noodles 1-2 min (or serve raw).
Toss with pesto, divide among 4 plates and top with cherry tomatoes.
Sauté onion, garlic, jalapeño. Add spices.
Add beans and broth. Simmer 20 min.
Blend half, stir back in.
Off heat: stir in cannabis oil and lime. Ladle into 4 bowls and serve with cilantro.
Blend frozen banana until smooth and creamy.
Add cannabis oil and vanilla; blend again.
Add optional mix-ins and pulse.
Serve as soft-serve or freeze 1h for scoopable texture. Divide into 4 bowls; one bowl is one serving.

ingredients: 2 tbsp cannabis olive oil to finish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss the red pepper, zucchini, red onion, cherry tomatoes and broccoli with the regular olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Roast 25-30 min tossing halfway.
Drizzle with the cannabis olive oil, toss, scatter basil and divide among 4 plates.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Mix cream cheese, cannabis butter, garlic and paprika.
Spread on bacon, top with jalapeño, roll and secure.
Bake 20-25 min until crispy. Makes 12 rolls; one serving is one roll.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss wings with baking powder and spices.
Bake on a rack 45-50 min flipping halfway.
Whisk cannabis butter, hot sauce and vinegar.
Toss hot wings in sauce, then divide among 4 plates; one plate is one serving.
Halve eggs; scoop yolks.
Mash yolks with cannabis butter, mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Pipe the filling evenly into the 12 egg-white halves; one serving is one filled half.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Sauté garlic in a little regular butter or oil for 1 min, let it cool slightly, then stir in the cannabis butter.
Mix with cream cheese, parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling evenly into the 12 caps. Bake 20-25 min. One serving is one stuffed mushroom.
Heat the regular olive oil in a large pot and brown the beef; drain fat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until soft.
Add spices, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 30 min.
Off heat: stir in cannabis oil. Divide among 4 bowls and serve with sour cream.
Preheat oven to 225°F.
Toss zucchini with cannabis oil and seasoning.
Arrange in single layer; sprinkle parmesan.
Bake 2-2.5h until crispy. Cool on pan, then divide into 4 equal portions; one portion is one serving.
Preheat waffle iron.
Whisk eggs, cannabis butter, milk and vanilla.
Add flours, baking powder and salt.
Pour a quarter of the batter into the waffle iron and cook until golden; repeat to make 4 waffles. One serving is one waffle. Serve with sugar-free syrup.
Mix salmon, egg, almond flour, mayonnaise, mustard, spring onions, salt and pepper.
Form 6 patties.
Heat the regular oil or butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook 3-4 min per side until golden. Off the heat, gently melt the cannabis butter and spoon an equal amount over each patty. Serve with lemon.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Sauté garlic in a little regular butter or oil for 1 minute. Add spinach and remove from the heat.
Stir in the cannabis butter, cream cheese, sour cream and half the mozzarella; season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to baking dish, top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan.
Bake 20-25 min until bubbling. Serve in 8 equal portions of about ⅓ cup each; one portion is one serving.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 8-inch pan.
Beat eggs, cannabis butter, erythritol and vanilla.
Stir in almond flour, baking powder, salt and lemon zest.
Bake 30-35 min. Cool completely.
Make cannabis syrup: dissolve sugar in water over heat, cool, stir in cannabis tincture.
Combine lemon juice and cannabis syrup.
Add ice, top with sparkling water. Garnish.
Muddle mint in a glass.
Add ice, lime juice and cannabis syrup.
Top with sparkling water. Garnish with lime.
Muddle cucumber and mint with syrup and lime.
Shake with ice and strain.
Top with sparkling water.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Blend watermelon, cannabis honey, lime and salt until smooth.
Pour into 3 glasses and top with mint.
Simmer water, sugar and lavender for 10 min; strain and let the syrup cool.

Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Stir the infused honey into 2 tbsp warm water until fully dissolved, then mix it with the lemon juice, syrup and water. Stir before pouring each of the 3 glasses over ice.

Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Stir the infused honey (and any plain honey) into 2 tbsp warm water until fully dissolved. Infused honey contains coconut oil, which hardens in cold drinks, so always dissolve it warm first, then stir or shake the drink well before serving.
Mix the juices, the honey mixture and lime in a pitcher.
Pour into 4 glasses over ice and top with sparkling water.
Muddle strawberries and basil with cannabis honey and lemon.
Strain over ice. Top with sparkling water.
Steep the hibiscus in the 4 cups boiling water for 10 min. Strain and let cool until just warm.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Stir in cannabis honey and lime. Pour into 4 glasses over ice and garnish with orange slices.
Pour the 4 cups hot water over the tea bags and brew 5 min. Remove the bags, add the peaches and steep 15 min.

Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Strain. Stir the infused honey into the tea while it is still warm, until fully dissolved, then add lemon, cool and refrigerate 1h. Stir again and pour into 4 glasses over ice.
Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Taste and adjust. Pour into glasses.
Mix lemon juice, rose syrup and cannabis tincture.
Stir, divide among 3 glasses over ice and top with the sparkling water. Garnish with rose petals.
Mix pineapple juice, ginger, cannabis honey and lime. Strain.
Pour over ice and top with sparkling water.
Mix cranberry juice, cannabis syrup and orange juice.
Add ice and sparkling water. Garnish.
Whisk matcha with hot water until smooth. Add cannabis honey.
Fill glass with ice and oat milk. Pour matcha over top.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Dissolve the infused honey in 2 tbsp warm water, then mix it with the passion fruit and lemon.
Stir, divide among 3 glasses over ice and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint.
Mix cherry juice, lime and cannabis syrup.
Pour over ice and top with sparkling water. Garnish.
Heat the 4 cups water until steaming but not boiling, and pour it over the tea bags.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Brew green tea 3 min. Stir in cannabis honey while warm.
Add mint and lemon. Cool, refrigerate. Stir, then pour into 4 glasses over ice.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Simmer the blueberries with ¼ cup water; strain. While the juice is still warm, stir in the infused honey until fully dissolved.
Mix the blueberry-honey juice with lemon and water. Stir well and pour into 4 glasses over ice.
Stir the jar of infused honey well before measuring. Combine ginger, turmeric, lemon and cannabis honey in warm water.
Cool, stir and divide between 2 glasses over ice; top with sparkling water. Add black pepper.
Mix coconut water, lime and cannabis honey until dissolved.
Add sparkling water over ice. Garnish.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Mix biscuits and cannabis butter; press into 9-inch springform.
Beat cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs one at a time.
Mix in vanilla, sour cream and flour. Pour over crust.
Bake in water bath 55-60 min. Cool in oven 1h.
Refrigerate 4h before serving.
Beat yolks and sugar until pale. Beat in mascarpone, cannabis butter and vanilla.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso; layer in dish.
Spread half the cream. Repeat layers.
Dust with cocoa. Refrigerate 4h+

Make the pastry: whisk the flour and salt, rub in the cold cannabutter and butter until pea-sized, then stir in the ice water a tablespoon at a time until the dough holds together. Halve it, flatten into discs and chill 1h. Preheat oven to 375°F.
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and cornstarch.
Line pan with half the dough. Add filling.
Top with second dough sheet; seal and crimp.
Bake 50-60 min until golden.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease 4 ramekins.
Melt chocolate and cannabis butter. Cool slightly.
Whisk in eggs, yolks and icing sugar. Fold in flour and salt.
Fill ramekins. Chill 30 min.
Bake 12-13 min. Rest 1 min then invert.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix the base flour, both butters, icing sugar and salt into a crumbly dough, then press into 8x8 pan. Bake 18 min.
Whisk the eggs, caster sugar, lemon juice and zest and the 3 tbsp flour. Pour over hot base.
Bake 20-22 min until set. Cool, then refrigerate within 2 hours.
Dust with icing sugar and cut into 16 bars; one bar is one serving.

ingredients: Frosting: 250g cream cheese, 1 cup icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk eggs, sugar, cannabis oil and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and grated carrot.
Bake in two 8-inch pans 30-35 min. Cool completely.
Beat frosting; fill and cover cake.
Preheat oven to 325°F.
Mix coconut, cannabis condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Fold in stiff egg whites.
Scoop 20 equal balls onto a lined tray. Bake 18-20 min.
Dip bases in melted chocolate when cool. One serving is one macaroon.
Melt chocolate, cannabis condensed milk and butter over low heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into lined 8x8 pan. Sprinkle sea salt.
Refrigerate 3-4h. Cut into squares.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk cannabis brown butter and brown sugar.
Add egg, yolk and vanilla. Fold in flour, baking powder, salt and chips.
Bake in lined 8x8 pan 22-25 min. Do not overbake.
Cool completely before cutting.

ingredients: Coating: ½ cup sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp cannabis butter melted
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Whisk milk, egg and cannabis butter; add to dry.
Heat oil to 350°F. Drop level tablespoons of batter, in batches, to make 20 donut holes; fry 2-3 min until golden.
Drain, brush with cannabis butter, roll in cinnamon sugar. One serving is one donut hole.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Toss peaches with sugar, lemon and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then stir in the milk and melted butters to a thick batter. Drop spoonfuls over peaches.
Bake 40-45 min until golden. Serve warm.

ingredients: Syrup: 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water, ½ cup honey, 1 tsp rose water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Toss the nuts with the cinnamon. Layer phyllo sheets brushing each with cannabis butter and nut mixture.
Score into 36 diamonds; one serving is one diamond. Bake 45-50 min until deep golden.
Simmer syrup 10 min; pour hot over hot baklava. Cool fully.
Heat cannabis cream until steaming. Remove from heat; add chocolate.
Rest 2 min then stir until smooth. Add butter, vanilla and salt.
Transfer to fondue pot and serve with dippers. You'll have about 2 cups of fondue; one serving is ⅓ cup, so ladle it into 6 small cups, one per guest.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut cannabis butter into dry ingredients.
Add cream and egg until just combined. Drop 8 equal mounds onto baking sheet.
Bake 15 min. Split and fill with strawberries and whipped cream. One serving is one filled shortcake.
Bloom gelatine in cold water 5 min.
Heat cannabis cream and sugar until dissolved. Off heat: stir in vanilla and gelatine.
Pour into 4 ramekins; one ramekin is one serving. Refrigerate 4h+.
Invert onto plates and serve with berry coulis.

ingredients: Coating: ½ cup sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon
instructions: Boil water, cannabis butter, sugar and salt. Add flour; stir until dough forms.
Cool 5 min then beat in eggs.
Pipe 16 churros of the same length into hot oil (350°F), in batches. Fry 3-4 min until golden. One serving is one churro.
Roll in cinnamon sugar. Serve with chocolate sauce.
Blend the flour, eggs, milk, melted cannabis butter, sugar, vanilla and salt until smooth. Rest 30 min.
Pour ¼ cup of batter per crepe into a buttered non-stick pan, swirl it thin and cook 1-2 min per side. Use all the batter to make 10 crepes; one crepe is one serving.
Fill and fold as desired.
Blend frozen mango, cannabis syrup, lime and salt until smooth.
Serve as soft-serve or freeze 1h for scoopable texture.

ingredients: Dough: 3 cups flour, 2¼ tsp yeast, ¼ cup sugar, 1 tsp salt, ¾ cup warm milk, 2 eggs, ¼ cup cannabis butter
Filling: 4 tbsp cannabis butter, ½ cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp cinnamon
Icing: 1 cup icing sugar, 2 tbsp cannabis butter, 2 tbsp milk
instructions: Mix and knead dough 8 min. Rise 1h.
Roll out, spread with cannabis butter, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll tightly, cut into 12 rolls; one roll is one serving. Rise 30 min. Bake at 375°F 20-25 min.
Drizzle with cannabis icing while warm.

ingredients: Toasted coconut and mango to serve
instructions: Whisk all ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring until thick (8-10 min).
Pour into 4 bowls; one bowl is one serving. Refrigerate 2h+.
Top with toasted coconut and mango.
Sauté onion and pepper in the regular olive oil. Add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes. Simmer 15 min. Season.
Make wells; crack eggs in. Cover and cook 6-8 min.

Off heat: mix the cannabis olive oil with the plain olive oil, drizzle it evenly over the pan, then top with parsley and feta. Divide among 4 plates with an equal share of eggs and sauce; serve with bread.

ingredients: ½ cup non-alcoholic white grape juice
instructions: Sauté onion in regular oil. Add garlic, mushrooms and thyme and cook until golden.
Add rice; stir to coat. Add grape juice; cook until absorbed.
Add broth one ladle at a time stirring until each is absorbed (20 min).
Off heat: stir in parmesan, butter and cannabis olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and divide among 4 plates.
Brown ground chicken in regular oil.
Add garlic and chillies. Add sauces and sugar.
Off heat: drizzle the infused coconut oil and the sesame oil, toss through basil. Divide the steamed rice among 4 plates and top with equal portions of the chicken.

ingredients: Shredded cabbage, salsa, lime, sour cream
instructions: Brown beef; drain fat. Add onion and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in spices. Cook 2 min. Off heat: stir in the cannabis butter until melted.
Warm the tortillas and divide the beef equally among them to make 8 tacos; top with the shredded cabbage, salsa, lime and sour cream. One taco is one serving.

ingredients: Dressing: 2 tbsp cannabis olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 1 garlic clove, 3 tbsp mayo, salt
instructions: Whisk all dressing ingredients.
Toss romaine with dressing.
Top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.
Stir-fry cauliflower rice 5 min. Set aside.
Scramble eggs in same pan. Add garlic and the frozen peas and corn; stir-fry until heated through.
Return cauliflower; add soy sauce. Toss.
Off heat: drizzle the infused coconut oil and the sesame oil and toss. Divide among 4 bowls and garnish with spring onions and sesame seeds.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery in regular oil.
Add garlic, zucchini and tomatoes. Add broth, beans and parmesan rind. Simmer 20 min.
Add pasta; cook al dente. Stir in spinach.
Off heat: stir in the cannabis olive oil, remove the parmesan rind and ladle into 6 bowls.

ingredients: 1 tsp each smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt
Cannabis BBQ sauce: 1 cup BBQ sauce + 2 tbsp cannabis butter
instructions: Rub pork with spices; slow cook on low 8h or oven at 300°F 4-5h.
Shred pork with forks.
Warm BBQ sauce with cannabis butter. Toss shredded pork in sauce.
Divide the pork equally among 12 slider buns and top with coleslaw; one serving is one slider.

ingredients: Dressing: 3 tbsp cannabis olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp oregano, salt
instructions: Combine vegetables and olives.
Whisk dressing and pour over. Toss.
Divide among 4 plates and top with feta. Serve with crusty bread.
Toss tomatoes, onion and garlic with the olive oil; roast at 400°F for 40 min.
Blend with broth until smooth.
Stir in cannabis cream and sugar; warm over low heat.
Season with salt and pepper, ladle into 4 bowls and top with fresh basil.

ingredients: 1 tsp each cumin, chili powder, garlic powder
Cannabis-lime dressing: juice of 2 limes + 2 tbsp cannabis olive oil
instructions: Season and grill chicken. Slice.
Build 4 bowls: rice, beans, corn, chicken.
Whisk the cannabis-lime dressing and drizzle it evenly over the 4 bowls. Top with avocado, salsa, sour cream and coriander.

ingredients: Cannabis tahini: 3 tbsp tahini + 2 tbsp cannabis olive oil + lemon + water
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander and flour. Refrigerate 30 min.
Form balls; fry at 350°F 3-4 min.
Whisk the tahini, cannabis olive oil, olive oil and lemon juice, adding water a little at a time until the dressing is pourable.
Divide the falafel, lettuce, tomato and cucumber among the flatbreads, add an equal spoonful of dressing to each and roll up to make 4 wraps; one wrap is one serving.
Brush the squash, onion and garlic with the olive oil and roast at 400°F for 45 min.
Scoop the squash flesh from the skin and blend with the onion, garlic and broth until smooth.
Stir in cannabis cream and nutmeg; warm gently.
Season with salt and pepper, ladle into 4 bowls and top with pumpkin seeds.
Stir-fry rice in regular oil until slightly crispy.
Push aside; scramble eggs.
Add garlic and peas; toss everything. Add soy sauce.
Off heat: drizzle cannabis sesame oil. Garnish.
Season salmon with salt and pepper and sear skin-side down 4 min until crispy.
Flip; cook 3 more min.
Melt the cannabis butter and unsalted butter with garlic, dill, lemon zest and juice; spoon evenly over the 4 fillets.
Serve one fillet per plate with capers and lemon; one serving is one fillet.

ingredients: 3 tbsp cannabis extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Arrange alternating tomato and mozzarella slices on 4 plates.
Tuck basil leaves between.
Mix the cannabis olive oil with the 2 tbsp olive oil and drizzle it evenly over the plates, then add the balsamic.
Finish with sea salt and pepper.

ingredients: 1 cup cooked chicken or black beans
instructions: Mix the cannabis butter with the unsalted butter and spread it evenly over one side of each tortilla.
Place a tortilla butter-side up in a dry pan; scatter a quarter of the cheddar, the chicken or beans, the red onion and the jalapeño over half.
Fold and cook over medium heat 3 min per side until golden. Repeat with the remaining tortillas to make 4 quesadillas.
Cut each into wedges and serve with sour cream and guacamole; one serving is one quesadilla.

ingredients: Spring onions, bean sprouts, peanuts, lime
instructions: Stir-fry shrimp or tofu. Scramble eggs in same pan.
Add noodles, soy sauce, tamarind and sugar. Toss 2 min.
Add spring onions and bean sprouts.
Off heat: drizzle cannabis sesame oil. Serve with peanuts and lime.

ingredients: Toppings: ½ cup tomato sauce, 150g mozzarella, toppings of choice
Extra cannabis olive oil to finish
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the flour, instant yeast and salt. Add the warm water and 1 tbsp of the cannabis olive oil and mix to a shaggy dough; knead 8 min until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise 1h until doubled.
Preheat oven to 475°F.
Stretch the dough on a pan greased with the regular olive oil; add sauce, cheese and toppings.
Bake 10-12 min until golden.
Drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp cannabis olive oil, then cut into 8 slices; one slice is one serving.
Fry cumin seeds until they pop. Add onion, garlic and ginger.
Add tomatoes and turmeric. Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 min.
Off heat: stir in cannabis ghee and garam masala.
Season with salt, ladle into 4 bowls and garnish with coriander. Serve with rice.

ingredients: 2 cups dried black beans, soaked overnight
150g dried beef (carne seca), soaked and diced
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Drain beans, cover with fresh water, add smoked ribs and bay leaves. Simmer 1.5–2 hours until beans are tender.
In a skillet, cook bacon until crispy. Add sausage, dried beef, onion and garlic; sauté 5 min.
Transfer skillet contents to bean pot. Simmer 30 min more and season with salt and black pepper.
Remove from heat and stir in cannabis olive oil.
Divide among 6 plates and serve over white rice with sautéed collard greens, farofa and orange slices.
Combine condensed milk, cocoa powder, cannabutter and a pinch of salt in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir constantly until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pan, about 10–15 min.
Transfer to a greased plate and let cool to room temperature.
Grease your hands with butter, roll into small balls of the same size, 24 in all, and coat in chocolate sprinkles.
Place in mini cupcake liners and refrigerate until firm.
Pulse peanuts in a food processor until you get a fine, slightly oily crumb.
Add sugar, melted cannabutter and salt. Pulse a few more times until combined.
Press mixture firmly into small cylindrical molds or a lined baking pan.
Refrigerate 1 hour until set, then unmold.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
Season shredded chicken with cream cheese, salt and pepper. Set aside.
In a saucepan, bring broth and cannabutter to a boil. Add flour all at once, stirring vigorously until dough forms a ball. Let cool.
Take a portion of dough, flatten in your palm, add chicken filling, and shape into a teardrop.
Dip in beaten egg, then roll in breadcrumbs.
Deep fry at 350°F until golden brown, about 3–4 min. Drain on paper towels.

ingredients: 1 cup grated Parmesan or Minas cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Heat milk, cannabis olive oil and salt until just simmering. Pour over tapioca flour and stir until combined.
Let cool slightly, then mix in egg and cheese until smooth.
Roll into 24 equal balls and place on a lined baking sheet; one ball is one serving.
Bake 20–25 min until puffed and golden.

ingredients: Toppings: granola, sliced banana, strawberries, honey, shredded coconut
instructions: Blend frozen açaí puree, frozen banana, almond milk and cannabis coconut oil until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola, sliced banana, strawberries, shredded coconut and a drizzle of honey.
Serve immediately.

ingredients: 500g firm white fish (cod or halibut), cut into chunks
instructions: Marinate fish in lime juice, salt and pepper for 30 min.
In a clay pot or deep pan, layer onion, peppers, tomatoes and fish.
Pour coconut milk and dendê oil over the top. Cover and simmer 20 min without stirring.
Remove from heat and gently stir in cannabis olive oil.
Garnish with cilantro. Ladle into 4 bowls over white rice.

ingredients: 1 cup hydrated tapioca starch (goma de tapioca)
Filling: shredded coconut, mozzarella or coalho cheese
instructions: Sift the tapioca starch with the pinch of salt through a fine sieve to remove lumps.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Spread half the tapioca starch in a thin, even layer across the pan.
When it turns translucent and holds together (about 1 min), add cheese and coconut to one half.
Fold and cook 1 min more until cheese melts.
Repeat with the rest of the starch to make 2 crepes. Mix the cannabis and plain coconut oil, drizzle half over each crepe with the condensed milk, and serve immediately. One serving is one crepe.

ingredients: ½ cup shredded coconut, plus more for rolling
instructions: Combine condensed milk, cannabutter, shredded coconut and a pinch of salt in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir constantly until mixture thickens and pulls away from the sides, about 10–12 min.
Transfer to a greased plate and cool to room temperature.
Roll into small balls of the same size, 20 in all, and coat in shredded coconut. Top each with a clove.
Place in mini cupcake liners and refrigerate until ready to serve.

ingredients: ½ cup cannabutter, cold and cubed
½ cup regular butter, cold and cubed
Filling: 2 cups shredded chicken, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, ½ cup green olives, ½ cup hearts of palm, 2 tbsp tomato paste, salt, pepper, parsley
instructions: Make dough: pulse flour, cannabutter, regular butter and egg yolks in a food processor. Add ice water until dough comes together. Wrap and refrigerate 30 min.
Make filling: sauté onion and garlic, add chicken, tomato paste, olives, hearts of palm, salt, pepper and parsley. Cook 5 min. Let cool.
Press ⅔ of dough into a greased pie dish. Add filling.
Roll remaining dough for top crust. Seal edges and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 375°F for 35–40 min until golden. Let it cool slightly, then cut into 8 equal slices; one slice is one serving.
